# v1.1.3 — catalog resynced to live, and the release gate now checks closed vocabularies

A maintenance release. The tool surface, naming and pricing are unchanged.

## What changed

- **`liquor-license-new-openings-tracker` now covers California.** Its `states`
  input gained `CA` (California ABC daily export). The 1.1.2 catalog still told
  agents TX/NY/FL were the only legal values, so an agent asking for California
  licences would have been steered away from a tool that answers the question.
- **`nhd-surface-water-404-screener` and `usgs-historical-topo-records-review`**
  gained an optional `runBudgetSeconds` input (a shared run-level deadline).
- **`ntad-fra-rail-crossing-risk-screener`**: `simulateOutage` vocabulary synced.

## Why this slipped past the 1.1.2 gate

`tools/check-catalog-live.cjs` diffed field names, `required[]` and price, but
not closed vocabularies. A new `enum` value is invisible to a field-name diff,
so the gate read green while the catalog was wrong. It now diffs `enum` and
`items.enum` per property, and on its first run it caught all three drifts above.

## What was verified and did not change

- 120 published Actors, same set — no additions, removals or renames.
- Zero price changes. No `required[]` changes.
- 15 tools exposed (12 featured + 3 meta), all hyphen-case, all annotated.

## Gates

`npm test` · `node tools/mutate.cjs` · `check:catalog` clean against live
(120/120, enums included) · registry constraints pinned and passing.
